s07.math.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Badala ya kutoa 7 zote mara moja, tunashuka hadi kumi kwanza.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.4.narration: Toa 2 za mwisho kutoka kwa kumi yetu.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.5.narration: Shuka hadi kumi, kisha shuka tena. Hiyo ndiyo njia yote.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.6.narration: Hii inafika kumi kwa hatua moja.
s07.math.lesson.03.steps.7.feedback: 9! Nne kufika kumi, kisha moja zaidi.

s07.math.lesson.04.steps.3.narration: Mamoja yaliyobaki ni yale yasiyoweza kufanya fungu.

s07.math.lesson.04.steps.6.narration: Kuwa makini na hii — hakuna mamoja yaliyobaki kabisa.
s07.math.lesson.04.steps.7.narration: Makumi yana thamani zaidi ya mamoja, kwa hiyo angalia makumi kwanza.

s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.1.feedback: Neno limebadilika, na sauti ya katikati pia.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Sasa tazama. Tunaongeza herufi moja mwishoni: cape.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.2.feedback: cape. e ipo lakini inakaa kimya.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: Soma tena: cape. e mpya haisemwi — huwa husemi kwa sauti.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.3.feedback: cap inakuwa cape. hop inakuwa hope.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.3.narration: Hii ndiyo ajabu: e isiyosemwa hufanya vokali isome jina lake. A inasema 'ei'.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.feedback: hope inayo. hop na hopping hazina.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.4.narration: Tafuta e ya kimya mwishoni mwa neno.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.5.narration: Kuna njia ya pili vokali kusaidiana. Vokali mbili pamoja, sauti moja: rain.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.6.narration: Tafuta herufi mbili zinazofanya kazi katika rain.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.feedback: train! Timu ile ile, sauti ile ile.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.narration: Sikiliza sauti ile ile ya /ei/ katika neno lingine.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.7.prompt: Neno lipi lina sauti sawa na rain?
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.8.feedback: Maneno manne mapya kutoka mtindo mmoja.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.8.narration: Ukiona timu unaweza kusoma familia nzima: rain, pain, mail, tail.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.9.feedback: tail — a na i tena. Sasa unasoma kwa mitindo.
s07.reading.lesson.01.steps.9.narration: Soma sentensi hii: 'The tail is long.'

s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Wakati mwingine herufi mbili husimama pamoja na unasikia zote. Sikiliza: bl katika black.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: Sema black polepole na sikiliza mwanzo kabisa.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Sauti 2. Unaweza kuzisikia zote ukienda polepole.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: Mchanganyiko ni sauti mbili, si sauti mpya moja.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.feedback: Jifunze mchanganyiko mmoja, fungua maneno mengi.
s07.reading.lesson.03.steps.3.narration: Michanganyiko pia ina familia: st katika stop, star, stand.

s10.social.story.01.pages.0.narration: Mji wa Greenfield ulikuwa na swali moja kubwa: je, kiwanja kitupu kiwe bustani au eneo la maegesho? Watu hawakukubaliana.
s10.social.story.01.pages.1.narration: Katika mkutano wa mji, kila mtu alisikiliza pande zote mbili. Kisha raia walipiga kura — mtu mmoja, kura moja. Gusa kupiga kura.
s10.social.story.01.pages.2.narration: Bustani ilishinda kwa tofauti ndogo. Wengine walikatishwa tamaa, lakini wote walikubali chaguo lilikuwa la haki. Hivyo ndivyo demokrasia inavyofanya kazi!
s10.social.story.01.title: Kura ya mji
s10.writing.lesson.01.recap.0.prompt: Ni sehemu ipi ya insha huja kwanza?
s10.writing.lesson.01.recap.1.prompt: Ni sehemu ipi hutoa sababu na maelezo?
s10.writing.lesson.01.steps.0.narration: UTANGULIZI hueleza wazo kuu na huvuta usikivu. Vuta juu.
s10.writing.lesson.01.steps.1.narration: Aya za MWILI hutoa sababu na maelezo. Vuta katikati.
s10.writing.lesson.01.steps.2.narration: HITIMISHO hufunga na kurudia wazo kuu. Vuta mwishoni.
s10.writing.lesson.01.title: Sehemu za insha
s10.writing.lesson.02.steps.0.narration: SENTENSI KUU hueleza wazo kuu la aya: 'Mbwa ni wanyama wazuri wa kufuga.' Gusa sentensi kuu.
s10.writing.lesson.02.steps.1.narration: Maelezo ya KUUNGA MKONO hutoa sababu: 'Ni waaminifu. Hutusaidia kufanya mazoezi.' Gusa maelezo ya kuunga mkono.
s10.writing.lesson.02.steps.2.narration: Aya imara ni wazo moja wazi pamoja na sababu zinazolingana nalo.
s10.writing.lesson.02.title: Sentensi kuu na maelezo
s10.writing.lesson.03.recap.1.prompt: Ni neno lipi linaonyesha sababu na tokeo?
s10.writing.lesson.03.steps.0.narration: Maneno ya mpito kama 'kwanza', 'kisha', na 'mwisho' huonyesha mpangilio. Gusa neno la mpangilio.
s10.writing.lesson.03.steps.1.narration: 'Hata hivyo' na 'lakini' huonyesha mabadiliko au tofauti. Gusa neno la tofauti.
s10.writing.lesson.03.steps.2.feedback: Maneno ya mpito hufanya uandishi kuwa laini!
s10.writing.lesson.03.steps.2.narration: 'Kwa sababu' na 'hivyo' huonyesha sababu na athari. Uandishi mzuri hutiririka kwa viunganishi.
s10.writing.lesson.03.title: Maneno ya kuunganisha
s10.writing.lesson.04.recap.0.prompt: Nini huwekwa kuzunguka maneno halisi yaliyosemwa?
s10.writing.lesson.04.recap.1.prompt: Mstari mpya huanza lini kwenye mazungumzo?
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.0.feedback: Alama za unukuzi huonyesha maneno yaliyosemwa.
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.0.narration: Weka alama za unukuzi kuzunguka maneno hasa yaliyosemwa: "Let's go," said Maria. Gusa alama za unukuzi.
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.1.feedback: Uakifishaji huingia ndani ya alama za unukuzi.
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.1.narration: Mkato huwekwa ndani kabla ya alama ya kufunga unukuzi wakati maelezo yanafuata. Gusa mkato.
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.2.feedback: Sasa mazungumzo yako ni wazi na sahihi!
s10.writing.lesson.04.steps.2.narration: Anza mstari mpya kila mtu mpya anaposema.
s10.writing.lesson.04.title: Kuakifisha mazungumzo
s10.writing.lesson.05.steps.0.narration: Uandishi wa MASIMULIZI husimulia hadithi. Gusa mfano wa hadithi.
s10.writing.lesson.05.steps.1.narration: Uandishi wa KUARIFU hueleza ukweli. Gusa mfano wa kueleza.
s10.writing.lesson.05.steps.2.narration: Uandishi wa KUSHAWISHI hujaribu kukushawishi. Gusa mfano wa kushawishi.
s10.writing.lesson.05.title: Aina tatu za uandishi
s10.writing.lesson.06.parentNote: Mwombe mtoto wako asome rasimu kwa sauti — humsaidia kugundua cha kuboresha.

s10.writing.lesson.06.steps.0.feedback: Kupitia upya hufanya maana kuwa imara zaidi.
s10.writing.lesson.06.steps.0.narration: KUPITIA UPYA huboresha mawazo: ongeza maelezo au neno wazi zaidi. Gusa sentensi inayohitaji maelezo zaidi.
s10.writing.lesson.06.steps.1.narration: KUHARIRI hurekebisha tahajia, herufi kubwa, na uakifishaji. Gusa kosa la kuhariri.
s10.writing.lesson.06.steps.2.feedback: Pitia upya, kisha hariri — hiyo ndiyo siri!
s10.writing.lesson.06.steps.2.narration: Waandishi wakuu husoma tena na kuboresha kazi zao.
s10.writing.lesson.06.title: Kupitia upya na kuhariri
